title: High-Altitude Archaeology Uncovers Earliest Evidence of Potato Consumption
lineage: Brief research notes paraphrase inspected passages; not a source copy.

passages.note: The university account reports potato consumption evidence at Jiskairumoko, Peru, dated between approximately 3400 and 2200 BCE. Its report describes the team’s 2016 study; the remains are archaeological interpretations, not direct proof that cultivation originated at this site.
